about: The reviewed languages of OpenStreetMap water names, read by tools/map/water-labels.mjs when it writes the map's labels in Latin letters. The rules there (the feature's own name:xx tags, letters only one language has, the names around it) decide almost every name; this list settles the few they get wrong. Most are rivers in Russia whose only language tag in OSM is a Ukrainian one (name:uk, the same spelling as the name, added as a translation), so the tag rule read them as Ukrainian; a few lie where the names around them are mostly in another country's language.
fields: name: the name as the label shows it before romanising (OSM's name, or the one part of it the label keeps). osmIds: the river or lake ids as in data/raw/derived/water-osm.json. lang: ru, be or uk. why: the reason, with where the feature lies (from its own map points).
